Proposed agenda:
- Overview introduction of [Light client roadmap for Electra](https://hackmd.io/@etan-status/electra-lc)
- Q&A about various proposals contained within the document
- Open discovery forum for builders/users of the light client protocol

Goal here is to understand why there isn't a lot of traction on this part of the protocol, what needs to be implemented to make it more viable and the best value for time tradeoff to improve protocol.

Thanks everyone for participating in the call. [Here is a summary of today's call](https://hackmd.io/@philknows/ryMFFQUpT). We do have access to the recording, not sure if EF uploads these @timbeiko ? But it's available upon demand, alongside the unedited transcription.
